title: ClawMMU: Protection-Coherent Virtual Memory for Stateful LLM Agents
title_zh: ClawMMU：面向有状态LLM智能体的保护一致虚拟内存

paragraphs.en: AI agents keep long-term memory, much of which comes from web pages and tool results. Agent harnesses, the software that runs the model, do not record who may act on this memory, so an instruction hidden in a fetched page can be treated as the user’s own instruction. We propose ClawMMU, a protection layer that labels every piece of memory with its owner, scope, origins, and authority. ClawMMU checks these labels whenever content enters the model’s context, is written to storage, returns from storage, or drives a tool call. Its central rule is that information may rise in authority, but authority never lifts itself. Because the checks depend on where content came from, not on what it says, memory attacks become classical protection faults that the harness stops even when the model is fooled.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体保有长期记忆，其中大部分来自网页和工具结果。 运行模型的智能体框架并不记录谁可以作用于这些记忆，因此藏在所抓取页面中的指令可能被当作用户自己的指令。 我们提出 ClawMMU，一个为每条记忆标注其所有者、范围、来源和权限的保护层。 ClawMMU 在内容进入模型上下文、写入存储、从存储返回或驱动工具调用时都会检查这些标签。 其核心规则是：信息可以提升权限，但权限绝不能自我提升。 由于这些检查取决于内容的来源而非其内容本身，记忆攻击就变成经典的保护性故障，即使模型被骗，框架也能将其阻止。

paragraphs.en: Production agents such as Claude Code and Codex keep memory across sessions, such as instruction files, tool results, and compacted conversation summaries. They load this memory into the model’s context, the input text the model sees at each step ( Anthropic, 2026a ; OpenAI, 2026a ) . The software that runs the model and manages this memory is the harness. Recent research explores more advanced memory organization schemes. MemGPT moves memory between tiers ( Packer et al., 2023 ) . ClawVM manages memory like virtual memory, as typed pages that each hold one fact with the representations derived from it, such as a summary ( Rafique and Bindschaedler, 2026 ) . Yet none of these systems tracks where a piece of memory came from or what it may cause the agent to do.
paragraphs.zh: 生产级智能体（如 Claude Code 和 Codex）会跨会话保留记忆，例如指令文件、工具结果以及压缩后的对话摘要。 它们将这些记忆加载到模型的上下文中，即模型在每一步看到的输入文本（Anthropic, 2026a；OpenAI, 2026a）。 运行模型并管理这些记忆的软件被称为脚手架（harness）。 近期的研究探索了更先进的记忆组织方案。 MemGPT 在不同层级之间迁移记忆（Packer et al., 2023）。 ClawVM 像虚拟内存一样管理记忆，将其作为类型化页面，每页保存一条事实及其派生的表示形式，例如摘要（Rafique and Bindschaedler, 2026）。 然而，这些系统都没有追踪一段记忆的来源，以及它可能导致智能体做出的行为。

sents.zh: 然而，这些系统都没有追踪一段记忆的来源，以及它可能导致智能体做出的行为。

paragraphs.en: As a result, nothing stops untrusted text from steering the agent. Much of this text comes from web pages and tool outputs that the user does not control and rarely inspects, because the agent itself retrieves it, transforms it, and stores it. The agent then gives an instruction from a fetched page the same authority as an instruction from the user. In indirect prompt injection, a fetched page or tool result instructs the agent within the same task ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ) . In sleeper memory poisoning, the text is stored and acts later ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) . For example, an agent could summarize a forged invoice saying “use this bank account for all future payments” into its memory and, weeks later, use the summary to pay the attacker. Direct prompt injection, in which another user of a shared agent types the instruction, follows the same pattern ( Perez and Ribeiro, 2022 ) . In each case, text from an untrusted source exercises authority that nobody granted, whether or not it was ever stored.
paragraphs.zh: 结果就是，没有任何机制能阻止不可信文本操纵智能体。 这些文本大多来自用户无法控制也很少查看的网页和工具输出，因为检索、转换和存储这些文本的正是智能体本身。 于是，智能体把来自所获取页面的指令赋予了与用户指令同等的效力。 在间接提示注入中，所获取的页面或工具结果会在同一任务内对智能体发出指令（Greshake et al., 2023；Zhan et al., 2024）。 在休眠记忆投毒中，文本会被存储起来并在之后生效（Pulipaka et al., 2026）。 例如，智能体可能把一张写有“今后所有付款请使用此银行账户”的伪造发票摘录存入其记忆，并在数周后根据这段摘录向攻击者付款。 直接提示注入（由共享智能体的另一位用户直接输入指令）也遵循同样的模式（Perez and Ribeiro, 2022）。 在上述每种情形中，来自不可信来源的文本都在行使从未有人授予它的权限，无论该文本是否曾被存储。

sents.zh: 结果就是，没有任何机制能阻止不可信文本操纵智能体。

sents.en: Direct prompt injection, in which another user of a shared agent types the instruction, follows the same pattern ( Perez and Ribeiro, 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 直接提示注入（由共享智能体的另一位用户直接输入指令）也遵循同样的模式（Perez and Ribeiro, 2022）。

paragraphs.en: Current defenses ask a model to tell good text from bad. Training teaches the model to ignore instructions in untrusted input ( Wallace et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , while detectors scan content for injected instructions. Both lower the attack rate but give no guarantee, because legitimate documents also contain instructions and attackers who tune their inputs against a specific defense bypass most published ones ( Nasr et al., 2026 ) . Persistence makes the problem harder, because a poisoned entry can pass through several summaries and transformations before it fires, by which point it reads like the agent’s own notes. Production agents also ask the user before risky tool calls ( Anthropic, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026b ) , but these checks do not know where the arguments came from.
paragraphs.zh: 现有防御要求模型自己区分好文本与坏文本。 训练教会模型忽略不可信输入中的指令（Wallace et al., 2024；Chen et al., 2025），而检测器则扫描内容以查找被注入的指令。 这两种方法都降低了攻击成功率，但都无法提供保证，因为合法文档同样包含指令，而且针对特定防御进行调优的攻击者可以绕过大多数已发表的防御（Nasr et al., 2026）。 持久性使问题更加棘手，因为一条被投毒的条目可能在触发之前经过多次摘要和变换，到那时它读起来就像智能体自己的笔记。 生产环境的智能体也会在执行有风险的工具调用前询问用户（Anthropic, 2026b；OpenAI, 2026b），但这些检查并不知道参数来自何处。

paragraphs.en: Operating systems solved a similar problem long ago. An operating system does not read memory contents to decide what a program may do. Instead, hardware called the memory management unit (MMU) attaches permissions to each page and checks them on every access. ClawVM brought paging, the movement of pages between fast and slow memory, to agent memory but not the protection, leaving a pager without an MMU. ClawMMU adds the missing protection. It attaches a label, called a protection descriptor, to every representation of a page and checks the label whenever content enters the context, is written to storage, returns from storage, or drives a tool call. The decision therefore depends on where content came from rather than on its wording, and it holds even when the model is fooled. ClawMMU guarantees that untrusted content can neither gain the user’s authority nor trigger an external action, such as a payment. It does not guarantee that the model makes the right call, that derived memory is correct, or that readable content stays confidential. ClawMMU needs only a hook at each of these points and stable page identities, so it applies beyond ClawVM.
paragraphs.zh: 操作系统早已解决过类似的问题。 操作系统不会通过读取内存内容来决定程序可以做什么。 相反，一种称为内存管理单元（MMU）的硬件为每个内存页附加权限，并在每次访问时进行检查。 ClawVM 将分页——即在快速内存与慢速内存之间移动页——引入了智能体记忆，却没有引入保护机制，等于留下了一个没有 MMU 的分页器。 ClawMMU 补上了缺失的保护机制。 它为每个页的表示附加一个称为保护描述符的标签，并在内容进入上下文、写入存储、从存储返回或驱动工具调用时检查该标签。 因此，判定取决于内容来自哪里，而不是取决于其措辞，即使模型被欺骗，这一判定依然成立。 ClawMMU 保证不可信内容既无法获得用户的权限，也无法触发外部动作，例如支付。 它不保证模型做出正确的调用，不保证派生记忆是正确的，也不保证可读内容保持机密。 ClawMMU 只需要在上述每个环节设置一个钩子以及稳定的页标识，因此其适用范围超出了 ClawVM。

sents.zh: 操作系统早已解决过类似的问题。

paragraphs.en: A protection descriptor is attached to each piece of memory and answers four questions about it. The owner says who produced it, such as the user or an agent. The scope says which tasks and sessions may use it. The origins say which pages it was built from. Finally, the authority says what the content may justify. Authority comes in ordered levels. For example, the outputs of tool calls and web searches get the lowest level, Evidence, which marks untrusted content that the model may read but never act on. Messages from the user get the highest level, Policy, which marks content that the owner approved. User preferences, such as a preferred airline, and instruction files written by a teammate correspond to intermediate levels.
paragraphs.zh: 每块内存都附加有一个保护描述符，它回答关于该内存的四个问题。 所有者说明该内存由谁产生，例如用户或某个智能体。 范围说明哪些任务和会话可以使用它。 来源说明它是从哪些页面构建而来的。 最后，权限说明该内容可以用作什么依据。 权限按有序的层级划分。 例如，工具调用和网络搜索的输出获得最低层级「证据」（Evidence），它标记模型可以读取但绝不能据此行动的不可信内容。 来自用户的消息获得最高层级「策略」（Policy），它标记所有者批准的内容。 用户偏好（例如偏好的航空公司）以及由团队成员编写的指令文件则对应中间层级。

sents.zh: 每块内存都附加有一个保护描述符，它回答关于该内存的四个问题。

sents.zh: 所有者说明该内存由谁产生，例如用户或某个智能体。

sents.en: The scope says which tasks and sessions may use it.
sents.zh: 范围说明哪些任务和会话可以使用它。

sents.zh: 来源说明它是从哪些页面构建而来的。

sents.zh: 最后，权限说明该内容可以用作什么依据。

sents.en: Authority comes in ordered levels.
sents.zh: 权限按有序的层级划分。

sents.en: For example, the outputs of tool calls and web searches get the lowest level, Evidence, which marks untrusted content that the model may read but never act on.
sents.zh: 例如，工具调用和网络搜索的输出获得最低层级「证据」（Evidence），它标记模型可以读取但绝不能据此行动的不可信内容。

sents.en: Messages from the user get the highest level, Policy, which marks content that the owner approved.
sents.zh: 来自用户的消息获得最高层级「策略」（Policy），它标记所有者批准的内容。

sents.en: User preferences, such as a preferred airline, and instruction files written by a teammate correspond to intermediate levels.
sents.zh: 用户偏好（例如偏好的航空公司）以及由团队成员编写的指令文件则对应中间层级。

paragraphs.en: Agents constantly derive new memory from old memory, for example by summarizing a document or compacting a conversation. A summary can repeat any instruction from its inputs, so it cannot be trusted more than its least trusted input. ClawMMU therefore determines the descriptor of derived memory with a single rule, the inheritance rule. Under this rule, derived memory gets the lowest authority among its inputs and may be used only where all of its inputs may be used. Its origins list all of its inputs. Its owner is whoever derived it. The rule treats the model itself as a lowest-authority input, because injected text can steer what the model writes. As a result, memory that the model writes stays Evidence. Only the owner can raise its authority, either by approving it directly or through an approval given in advance. This is what we mean by saying that authority never lifts itself.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体不断从旧记忆中派生新记忆，例如通过总结一份文档或压缩一段对话。 摘要可以重复其输入中的任何指令，因此它的可信度不会高于其可信度最低的输入。 因此，ClawMMU 用一条单一规则来确定派生记忆的描述符，即继承规则。 在该规则下，派生记忆获得其输入中最低的权限，并且只能在所有输入都可被使用的地方使用。 其来源列表列出它的全部输入。 其所有者是派生它的那个智能体。 该规则将模型本身视为最低权限的输入，因为被注入的文本可以引导模型所写的内容。 因此，模型写下的记忆始终保持为证据（Evidence）。 只有所有者才能提升其权限，方式是直接批准它，或通过事先给出的批准。 这就是我们所说的“权限永远不会自行提升”的含义。

sents.en: Agents constantly derive new memory from old memory, for example by summarizing a document or compacting a conversation.
sents.zh: 智能体不断从旧记忆中派生新记忆，例如通过总结一份文档或压缩一段对话。

sents.en: A summary can repeat any instruction from its inputs, so it cannot be trusted more than its least trusted input.
sents.zh: 摘要可以重复其输入中的任何指令，因此它的可信度不会高于其可信度最低的输入。

sents.en: ClawMMU therefore determines the descriptor of derived memory with a single rule, the inheritance rule.
sents.zh: 因此，ClawMMU 用一条单一规则来确定派生记忆的描述符，即继承规则。

sents.en: Under this rule, derived memory gets the lowest authority among its inputs and may be used only where all of its inputs may be used.
sents.zh: 在该规则下，派生记忆获得其输入中最低的权限，并且只能在所有输入都可被使用的地方使用。

sents.en: Its origins list all of its inputs.
sents.zh: 其来源列表列出它的全部输入。

sents.en: Its owner is whoever derived it.
sents.zh: 其所有者是派生它的那个智能体。

sents.en: The rule treats the model itself as a lowest-authority input, because injected text can steer what the model writes.
sents.zh: 该规则将模型本身视为最低权限的输入，因为被注入的文本可以引导模型所写的内容。

sents.en: As a result, memory that the model writes stays Evidence.
sents.zh: 因此，模型写下的记忆始终保持为证据（Evidence）。

sents.en: Only the owner can raise its authority, either by approving it directly or through an approval given in advance.
sents.zh: 只有所有者才能提升其权限，方式是直接批准它，或通过事先给出的批准。

sents.en: This is what we mean by saying that authority never lifts itself.
sents.zh: 这就是我们所说的“权限永远不会自行提升”的含义。

paragraphs.en: The owner may later find a source malicious and revoke it, and all memory derived from that source must then become invalid. Each page therefore carries a revocation counter that increases when the page is revoked. Each descriptor records the counters of all the pages its memory came from, so a source whose counter has since increased invalidates the memory. Appendix A gives the details.
paragraphs.zh: 所有者之后可能发现某个来源是恶意的并撤销它，此时从该来源派生的所有记忆都必须失效。 因此每个页面携带一个撤销计数器，当页面被撤销时该计数器增加。 每个描述符记录其记忆所来自的所有页面的计数器，因此某个来源的计数器若在此后增加，就会使其派生的记忆失效。 附录 A 给出了细节。

sents.en: The owner may later find a source malicious and revoke it, and all memory derived from that source must then become invalid.
sents.zh: 所有者之后可能发现某个来源是恶意的并撤销它，此时从该来源派生的所有记忆都必须失效。

sents.en: Each page therefore carries a revocation counter that increases when the page is revoked.
sents.zh: 因此每个页面携带一个撤销计数器，当页面被撤销时该计数器增加。

sents.en: Each descriptor records the counters of all the pages its memory came from, so a source whose counter has since increased invalidates the memory.
sents.zh: 每个描述符记录其记忆所来自的所有页面的计数器，因此某个来源的计数器若在此后增加，就会使其派生的记忆失效。

sents.en: Appendix A gives the details.
sents.zh: 附录 A 给出了细节。

paragraphs.en: ClawMMU checks protection descriptors at four crossings of the model’s context boundary (Figure 1 ), much as an MMU checks memory accesses. New external content enters through map , corresponding to mapping a new page. Content leaving for storage passes through derive , corresponding to paging out. Stored content returning through retrieval or checkpoint restore passes through reload , corresponding to paging in. Finally, content leaving as an action, such as a tool call, passes through authorize , corresponding to the permission check on each memory access. We follow the invoice across all four crossings.
paragraphs.zh: ClawMMU 在模型上下文边界的四个交叉点检查保护描述符（图 1 ），就像内存管理单元（MMU）检查内存访问一样。 新的外部内容通过 map 进入，对应于映射一个新页。 离开并存入存储的内容经过 derive，对应于换出（paging out）。 通过检索或检查点恢复返回的存储内容经过 reload，对应于换入（paging in）。 最后，作为动作（例如工具调用）离开的内容经过 authorize，对应于每次内存访问时的权限检查。 我们沿着一张发票追踪全部四个交叉点。

sents.en: ClawMMU checks protection descriptors at four crossings of the model’s context boundary (Figure 1 ), much as an MMU checks memory accesses.
sents.zh: ClawMMU 在模型上下文边界的四个交叉点检查保护描述符（图 1 ），就像内存管理单元（MMU）检查内存访问一样。

sents.en: New external content enters through map , corresponding to mapping a new page.
sents.zh: 新的外部内容通过 map 进入，对应于映射一个新页。

sents.en: Content leaving for storage passes through derive , corresponding to paging out.
sents.zh: 离开并存入存储的内容经过 derive，对应于换出（paging out）。

sents.en: Stored content returning through retrieval or checkpoint restore passes through reload , corresponding to paging in.
sents.zh: 通过检索或检查点恢复返回的存储内容经过 reload，对应于换入（paging in）。

sents.en: Finally, content leaving as an action, such as a tool call, passes through authorize , corresponding to the permission check on each memory access.
sents.zh: 最后，作为动作（例如工具调用）离开的内容经过 authorize，对应于每次内存访问时的权限检查。

sents.en: We follow the invoice across all four crossings.
sents.zh: 我们沿着一张发票追踪全部四个交叉点。

paragraphs.en: When new content enters the context, map assigns its descriptor from its source. Each context, called a compartment, is built for one owner and one scope, so private notes stay out of other tasks. Two compartments can share a context only if the owner explicitly allows it (Appendix A ). This check therefore stops content from reaching a context it does not belong to, which operating systems call an address-space violation. Map admits the fetched invoice as Evidence, because it came from a tool call. The model can read the invoice, but nothing written in it can change its label.
paragraphs.zh: 当新内容进入上下文时，map（映射）会根据其来源赋予它相应的描述符。 每个上下文称为一个隔间（compartment），为单一所有者和单一作用域构建，因此私人笔记不会泄露到其他任务中。 两个隔间只有在所有者明确允许的情况下才能共享一个上下文（附录 A）。 因此，这项检查会阻止内容到达它不属于的上下文，操作系统将此称为地址空间违规。 Map 将获取到的发票作为证据（Evidence）接纳，因为它来自一次工具调用。 模型可以读取这张发票，但其中写入的任何内容都无法改变它的标签。

sents.en: When new content enters the context, map assigns its descriptor from its source.
sents.zh: 当新内容进入上下文时，map（映射）会根据其来源赋予它相应的描述符。

sents.en: Each context, called a compartment, is built for one owner and one scope, so private notes stay out of other tasks.
sents.zh: 每个上下文称为一个隔间（compartment），为单一所有者和单一作用域构建，因此私人笔记不会泄露到其他任务中。

sents.zh: 两个隔间只有在所有者明确允许的情况下才能共享一个上下文（附录 A）。

sents.en: This check therefore stops content from reaching a context it does not belong to, which operating systems call an address-space violation.
sents.zh: 因此，这项检查会阻止内容到达它不属于的上下文，操作系统将此称为地址空间违规。

sents.zh: Map 将获取到的发票作为证据（Evidence）接纳，因为它来自一次工具调用。

paragraphs.en: When the model writes content to storage, derive attaches the descriptor that the inheritance rule computes to the stored copy. The content therefore comes back later with that authority and nothing more, so the invoice summary returns as Evidence. This check stops type confusion, in which untrusted text becomes policy by passing through a summary.
paragraphs.zh: 当模型将内容写入存储时，derive 会将继承规则计算出的描述符附加到存储副本上。 因此内容之后返回时只带有该权限而无其他权限，所以发票摘要以 Evidence 的形式返回。 这一检查阻止了类型混淆，即不可信文本通过摘要变成策略。

sents.en: When the model writes content to storage, derive attaches the descriptor that the inheritance rule computes to the stored copy.
sents.zh: 当模型将内容写入存储时，derive 会将继承规则计算出的描述符附加到存储副本上。

sents.en: The content therefore comes back later with that authority and nothing more, so the invoice summary returns as Evidence.
sents.zh: 因此内容之后返回时只带有该权限而无其他权限，所以发票摘要以 Evidence 的形式返回。

sents.en: This check stops type confusion, in which untrusted text becomes policy by passing through a summary.
sents.zh: 这一检查阻止了类型混淆，即不可信文本通过摘要变成策略。

paragraphs.en: When stored content returns to the context through a retrieval or a checkpoint restore, it already has a descriptor, but that descriptor may no longer be valid. Reload therefore compares the counters recorded in the descriptor with the current ones. Suppose the owner reports the invoice as forged and revokes it, so its counter goes from 0 to 1. When the agent later retrieves the summary, reload sees that the summary recorded the invoice at 0 and does not trust the stored descriptor. The summary instead goes through map again. Because the current counters are kept outside checkpoints, restoring an old checkpoint cannot make the summary valid again. This check therefore stops use-after-revoke, the use of memory whose source has been revoked.
paragraphs.zh: 当存储的内容通过检索或检查点恢复回到上下文时，它已经带有描述符，但该描述符可能已经失效。 因此 reload 会将描述符中记录的计数器与当前计数器进行比较。 假设所有者举报该发票为伪造并撤销它，那么它的计数器从 0 变为 1。 当智能体之后检索该摘要时，reload 发现摘要在记录时发票的计数器为 0，于是不再信任存储的描述符。 该摘要转而重新经过 map。 由于当前计数器保存在检查点之外，恢复旧检查点无法使摘要重新生效。 因此这一检查阻止了「撤销后使用」，即使用其来源已被撤销的记忆。

sents.en: When stored content returns to the context through a retrieval or a checkpoint restore, it already has a descriptor, but that descriptor may no longer be valid.
sents.zh: 当存储的内容通过检索或检查点恢复回到上下文时，它已经带有描述符，但该描述符可能已经失效。

sents.zh: 因此 reload 会将描述符中记录的计数器与当前计数器进行比较。

sents.zh: 假设所有者举报该发票为伪造并撤销它，那么它的计数器从 0 变为 1。

sents.zh: 当智能体之后检索该摘要时，reload 发现摘要在记录时发票的计数器为 0，于是不再信任存储的描述符。

sents.en: The summary instead goes through map again.
sents.zh: 该摘要转而重新经过 map。

sents.en: Because the current counters are kept outside checkpoints, restoring an old checkpoint cannot make the summary valid again.
sents.zh: 由于当前计数器保存在检查点之外，恢复旧检查点无法使摘要重新生效。

sents.en: This check therefore stops use-after-revoke, the use of memory whose source has been revoked.
sents.zh: 因此这一检查阻止了「撤销后使用」，即使用其来源已被撤销的记忆。

paragraphs.en: The model’s decision to call a tool may be influenced by anything in its context. Controlling that decision would require ClawMMU to understand what the content means and how the model reasons about it, which no label captures. Authorize instead protects the integrity of the call’s arguments. Each security-relevant value, such as a payee, must trace to content with enough authority and to no revoked source. In the example, the payee traces to the invoice, so authorize rejects the payment unless the owner approves it. The model may still make the wrong call, or pass a wrong value that does have enough authority. However, it cannot pass a value that untrusted content supplied, nor one that the model made up. This check stops confused-deputy attacks, in which untrusted content misuses the agent’s permissions. Appendix B gives the details.
paragraphs.zh: 模型调用工具的决定可能受其上下文中任何内容的影响。 要控制这一决定，就需要 ClawMMU 理解内容的含义以及模型如何对其进行推理，而没有任何标签能捕捉到这一点。 「授权」机制则保护调用参数的完整性。 每个与安全相关的值（例如收款人）都必须能追溯到具有足够权限的内容，且不能追溯到已被撤销的来源。 在该示例中，收款人可追溯到发票，因此除非所有者批准，否则授权机制会拒绝该付款。 模型仍可能做出错误的调用，或传入一个虽有足够权限但错误的值。 然而，它无法传入由不可信内容提供的值，也无法传入模型自己编造的值。 这项检查可以阻止「困惑代理人」攻击，即不可信内容滥用智能体的权限。 附录 B 给出了详细内容。

sents.zh: 模型调用工具的决定可能受其上下文中任何内容的影响。

sents.zh: 这项检查可以阻止「困惑代理人」攻击，即不可信内容滥用智能体的权限。

sents.en: Appendix B gives the details.
sents.zh: 附录 B 给出了详细内容。

paragraphs.en: Untrusted content enters as Evidence and stays Evidence without the owner, even after it is stored and reloaded. Nor can its values become the arguments of an action. No step depends on the model resisting the attack, so a fooled model can propose a harmful action, but the harness refuses it.
paragraphs.zh: 不可信内容以证据（Evidence）的形式进入，并始终保持为证据（Evidence），即使经过存储和重新加载之后也是如此。 其值也不能成为某个动作的参数。 没有任何步骤依赖于模型抵御攻击，因此被欺骗的模型可以提出一个有害动作，但执行框架（harness）会拒绝它。

sents.en: Untrusted content enters as Evidence and stays Evidence without the owner, even after it is stored and reloaded.
sents.zh: 不可信内容以证据（Evidence）的形式进入，并始终保持为证据（Evidence），即使经过存储和重新加载之后也是如此。

sents.en: Nor can its values become the arguments of an action.
sents.zh: 其值也不能成为某个动作的参数。

sents.en: No step depends on the model resisting the attack, so a fooled model can propose a harmful action, but the harness refuses it.
sents.zh: 没有任何步骤依赖于模型抵御攻击，因此被欺骗的模型可以提出一个有害动作，但执行框架（harness）会拒绝它。

paragraphs.en: The inheritance rule of ClawMMU, which gives derived memory the lowest authority of its inputs, is the classical low-water-mark integrity policy, in which anything that reads untrusted data becomes untrusted itself ( Biba, 1977 ) . Compartments and the rule that only the owner raises authority follow operating systems such as HiStar ( Zeldovich et al., 2006 ) and Flume ( Krohn et al., 2007 ) , which label every object and control data flow between labels. Agent memory adds two cases these systems did not face, because an untrusted model produces derived data and checkpoints restore old state.
paragraphs.zh: ClawMMU 的继承规则——派生记忆获得其输入中最低的权限——正是经典的低水位标记完整性策略，即任何读取了不可信数据的事物本身也变为不可信（Biba, 1977）。 分区以及只有所有者才能提升权限的规则，遵循了 HiStar（Zeldovich et al., 2006）和 Flume（Krohn et al., 2007）等操作系统的做法，这些系统为每个对象打上标签并控制标签之间的数据流。 智能体记忆增加了这些系统未曾面对的两种情形，因为不可信的模型会产生派生数据，而检查点会恢复旧状态。

sents.en: The inheritance rule of ClawMMU, which gives derived memory the lowest authority of its inputs, is the classical low-water-mark integrity policy, in which anything that reads untrusted data becomes untrusted itself ( Biba, 1977 ) .
sents.zh: ClawMMU 的继承规则——派生记忆获得其输入中最低的权限——正是经典的低水位标记完整性策略，即任何读取了不可信数据的事物本身也变为不可信（Biba, 1977）。

sents.en: Compartments and the rule that only the owner raises authority follow operating systems such as HiStar ( Zeldovich et al., 2006 ) and Flume ( Krohn et al., 2007 ) , which label every object and control data flow between labels.
sents.zh: 分区以及只有所有者才能提升权限的规则，遵循了 HiStar（Zeldovich et al., 2006）和 Flume（Krohn et al., 2007）等操作系统的做法，这些系统为每个对象打上标签并控制标签之间的数据流。

sents.en: Agent memory adds two cases these systems did not face, because an untrusted model produces derived data and checkpoints restore old state.
sents.zh: 智能体记忆增加了这些系统未曾面对的两种情形，因为不可信的模型会产生派生数据，而检查点会恢复旧状态。

paragraphs.en: Recent agent defenses each cover part of this problem, but none combines memory labels, revocation that survives checkpoint restore, and per-argument checks ( Debenedetti et al., 2026 ; Louck, 2026 ; Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Appendix C compares their guarantees system by system. ClawMMU also adds owner-and-scope separation that is denied by default.
paragraphs.zh: 最近的智能体防御各自覆盖了这一问题的一部分，但没有一种能同时结合记忆标签、能在检查点恢复后仍然生效的撤销机制以及逐参数检查（Debenedetti et al., 2026; Louck, 2026; Ouyang and Hou, 2026; Li et al., 2026; Zheng et al., 2026）。 附录 C 逐个系统地比较了它们所提供的保证。 ClawMMU 还增加了默认拒绝的所有者与作用域分离机制。

sents.zh: 最近的智能体防御各自覆盖了这一问题的一部分，但没有一种能同时结合记忆标签、能在检查点恢复后仍然生效的撤销机制以及逐参数检查（Debenedetti et al., 2026; Louck, 2026; Ouyang and Hou, 2026; Li et al., 2026; Zheng et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Appendix C compares their guarantees system by system.
sents.zh: 附录 C 逐个系统地比较了它们所提供的保证。

sents.en: ClawMMU also adds owner-and-scope separation that is denied by default.
sents.zh: ClawMMU 还增加了默认拒绝的所有者与作用域分离机制。

paragraphs.en: We believe agent systems should make memory protection independent of applications, as operating systems did. As a first step, we will run attacks from AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , and sleeper memory poisoning ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) through a ClawVM-based harness and measure attack success, check latency, and how often the owner must approve an action. Open problems include reviewing capability schemas at scale, placing authority in multi-agent systems, handling actions that happen before a revocation, and auditing approvals that widen scope.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，智能体系统应当像操作系统那样，让内存保护独立于应用程序之外。 作为第一步，我们将把来自 AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）、InjecAgent（Zhan et al., 2024）以及休眠式记忆投毒（Pulipaka et al., 2026）的攻击在一个基于 ClawVM 的测试框架中运行，并测量攻击成功率、检查延迟，以及所有者必须批准操作的频率。 开放性问题包括：大规模审查能力模式、在多智能体系统中分配权限、处理在撤销之前已发生的操作，以及审计那些扩大权限范围的批准。

sents.en: We believe agent systems should make memory protection independent of applications, as operating systems did.
sents.zh: 我们认为，智能体系统应当像操作系统那样，让内存保护独立于应用程序之外。

sents.en: As a first step, we will run attacks from AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , InjecAgent ( Zhan et al., 2024 ) , and sleeper memory poisoning ( Pulipaka et al., 2026 ) through a ClawVM-based harness and measure attack success, check latency, and how often the owner must approve an action.
sents.zh: 作为第一步，我们将把来自 AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）、InjecAgent（Zhan et al., 2024）以及休眠式记忆投毒（Pulipaka et al., 2026）的攻击在一个基于 ClawVM 的测试框架中运行，并测量攻击成功率、检查延迟，以及所有者必须批准操作的频率。

sents.en: Open problems include reviewing capability schemas at scale, placing authority in multi-agent systems, handling actions that happen before a revocation, and auditing approvals that widen scope.
sents.zh: 开放性问题包括：大规模审查能力模式、在多智能体系统中分配权限、处理在撤销之前已发生的操作，以及审计那些扩大权限范围的批准。

paragraphs.en: Two compartments can share a context only through an assembly capability, an unforgeable token that the owner grants. The token allows the model to read both compartments together, but it raises the authority of nothing in them.
paragraphs.zh: 两个隔间只能通过一种组装能力（assembly capability）共享上下文，这是一种由所有者授予的不可伪造的令牌。 该令牌允许模型同时读取两个隔间，但它不会提升其中任何内容的权限。

paragraphs.en: Revoking a source must invalidate everything derived from it, including copies in caches, search indexes, or checkpoints that the harness cannot easily find and delete. ClawMMU therefore detects invalid memory when the memory is used, rather than deleting it when the source is revoked. Every page has a revocation counter, which starts at zero and increases by one whenever the owner revokes or corrects the page. When ClawMMU derives new memory, it copies the current counters of all the pages that the memory came from, directly or indirectly, into its descriptor. The origins field already lists these pages. A recorded counter that is lower than the current one therefore shows that the memory was built from a revoked or outdated source, while unrelated memory stays valid. Reload and authorize make this comparison, and the current counters are kept outside checkpoints so that a restore cannot roll them back.
paragraphs.zh: 撤销一个来源必须使其派生出的一切内容失效，包括 harness 无法轻易找到并删除的缓存、搜索索引或检查点中的副本。 因此，ClawMMU 在记忆被使用时检测其是否失效，而不是在来源被撤销时删除它。 每个页面都有一个撤销计数器，初始值为零，每当所有者撤销或更正该页面时就加一。 当 ClawMMU 派生新记忆时，它将该记忆直接或间接来自的所有页面的当前计数器复制到其描述符中。 origins 字段已经列出了这些页面。 因此，记录的计数器低于当前值就表明该记忆是由已撤销或过期的来源构建的，而无关的记忆仍然有效。 重新加载和授权会进行这种比较，且当前计数器保存在检查点之外，以便恢复操作无法将其回滚。

paragraphs.en: To know which arguments matter, each tool has a reviewed capability schema that marks every argument as checked, safe to take from anywhere, or uncovered. A checked argument must trace to content with the authority that the schema requires. The harness refuses calls with uncovered arguments. It also tracks the source of each argument value and gives an untraceable value the lowest authority. A wrong safe marking is therefore the main residual risk, which is why the schemas must be reviewed.
paragraphs.zh: 要知道哪些参数重要，每个工具都有一份经过审核的能力模式，将每个参数标记为「已核验」、「可从任意来源安全获取」或「未覆盖」。 「已核验」的参数必须能够追溯到具有该模式所要求权限的内容。 执行框架会拒绝包含未覆盖参数的调用。 它还会追踪每个参数值的来源，并将无法追溯的值赋予最低权限。 因此，错误的「可安全获取」标记是主要的残余风险，这也是为什么这些模式必须经过审核。

paragraphs.en: Permissions that the owner grants in advance follow a stricter rule. A standing permission, such as paying the rent monthly, applies only if no untrusted content entered the context that proposed the call. Otherwise, the owner must approve the exact call. Untrusted content therefore cannot create, choose, or redirect a permission.
paragraphs.zh: 所有者预先授予的权限遵循更严格的规则。 长期权限（例如每月支付房租）仅在提议该调用的上下文中没有不可信内容进入时才适用。 否则，所有者必须批准确切的调用。 因此，不可信内容无法创建、选择或重定向权限。

paragraphs.en: CaMeL checks tool arguments only within one execution [ Debenedetti et al., 2026 ] . TMA-NM [ Louck, 2026 ] and MemLineage [ Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ] carry labels through memory but do not revoke derived memory. MemTX revokes derived memory but does not check tool arguments [ Li et al., 2026 ] . ACRFence protects restores but not revoked memory [ Zheng et al., 2026 ] . Compared with these systems, ClawMMU adds owner-and-scope separation that is denied by default and revocation that survives checkpoint restore.
paragraphs.zh: CaMeL 仅在单次执行内检查工具参数 [ Debenedetti et al., 2026 ]。 TMA-NM [ Louck, 2026 ] 和 MemLineage [ Ouyang and Hou, 2026 ] 在记忆中传递标签，但不撤销派生记忆。 MemTX 撤销派生记忆但不检查工具参数 [ Li et al., 2026 ]。 ACRFence 保护恢复过程但不保护被撤销的记忆 [ Zheng et al., 2026 ]。 与这些系统相比，ClawMMU 增加了默认拒绝的所有者与作用域分离，以及能在检查点恢复后仍然生效的撤销机制。
